items.title: Smart suggestions in a new chat
items.summary: The new-chat empty state used to show four fixed prompt cards. Now it shows four suggestions worked out on the machine from where you are: the branch, uncommitted changes, recent chats, open comment tasks, issues, docs, canvases, agent runs and the time of day.

features.name: Suggestions from where you are
features.what: Before: four fixed cards (Walk me through how Tempo works, Create a design system canvas, Write a PRD, Scaffold a prototype). Now: four cards ranked by local rules, one per topic, e.g. a comment task waiting for you, a failed task, an interrupted chat or a large set of uncommitted changes.
features.how: Open a new chat. The cards appear under the composer, in the same style as the native ones.
features.video: pending: not captured yet

features.name: One click sends the prompt
features.what: Before: clicking a card only filled the composer. Now: the card fills the composer through the app's own path and then presses send for you.
features.how: Click a card. To keep fill-only, set localStorage "rtd.smartSuggestions.send" to "fill".
features.video: pending: not captured yet

features.name: More… list
features.what: Before: nothing beyond the four cards. Now: a fifth, discreet chip opens the full ranked list of 8 to 10 suggestions.
features.how: Click More… next to the cards.
features.video: pending: not captured yet

features.name: Optional re-rank with the decision model
features.what: Before: no ranking. Now: when the Decision model is set up and its suggestions automation is on, one call scores the candidates and moves close calls by up to 15 points, never burying an urgent one. Only names and counts are sent, never message text or paths.
features.how: Settings › Decision model, turn on the suggestions automation.
features.video: pending: needs the real app with a configured decision model

features.name: Live refresh and off switch
features.what: The cards refresh at once on a workspace or chat switch and after 2 s for other changes; only a card whose content changed cross-fades. Turning the mod off brings the native cards back.
features.how: Set localStorage "rtd.smartSuggestions" to "off" to go back to the original cards.
features.video: pending: not captured yet

items.title: Canvas layout like pen.dev
items.summary: The design canvas gets pen.dev's layout: a floating left card with tabs, a compact vertical tool rail, a composer at the bottom, a selection pill whose dropdown holds the properties, zoom at the bottom right and pills at the top. The app's own panels and buttons are reused, only placed differently.

features.name: Floating left card with tabs
features.what: Before: the canvas's left panel was a fixed column. Now: it floats over the canvas as a rounded card with a tab row: Agent and Layers, then Prototype, Components and Library once a mod fills them. Layers is the native panel, untouched.
features.how: Open or close it as before (the round toggle or Cmd+\). Click a tab to switch.

features.name: Compact vertical tool rail
features.what: Before: the Design tools bar sat at the bottom centre. Now: the same buttons, shortcuts and menus form a compact rail with pen.dev's sizes, next to the left card. Tools with options show a small corner mark and open their menu on a long press. If the rail does not fit, the horizontal bar stays above the composer.
features.how: Use the tools as before. Press and hold a tool with a corner mark to see its options.

features.name: Composer and chat chip at the bottom
features.what: Before: prompts went through the chat panel only. Now: a floating composer ("Design anything…", effort, model, send) sits at the bottom centre, with a chip above it: the chat button, the active chat's title and the agents working on comments. Enter sends an agent task anchored to the selection; Cmd+Enter sends to the canvas chat.
features.how: Type in the composer at the bottom and press Enter, or Cmd+Enter for the chat. Shift+Enter adds a line.

features.what: Setting the flag off gives back the previous layout at once. Other mods add tabs, right-panel sections, tools and top-right buttons through registerLeftTab, registerRightSection, registerTool and registerTopAction.
features.how: localStorage "rtd.canvasChrome" = "off" turns the layout off.

items.title: Browser card inside the canvas
items.summary: A globe in the canvas's top right pill opens pen.dev's side browser as a card floating inside the canvas. From it a page, one element or a screenshot can be brought onto the canvas.

features.name: Browser card and globe button
features.what: Before: browsing meant a separate Browser tab or a browser frame placed on the canvas. Now: the globe opens a card 12 px inside the canvas edges, the canvas stays visible around it and the floating pieces on the right move left. It works on the Design route, in chat canvas tabs and in panes.
features.how: Click the globe in the top right pill, or press Option+Cmd+B with a canvas on screen. Esc inside the card closes it.

features.how: Pick a mode in the empty card or use Import and the camera in the bar. In element mode, hover and click; Esc cancels.

items.title: Code and Export in the canvas panel
items.summary: With one storyboard selected, the canvas's right panel gets pen.dev's Code and Export sections: copy or export its HTML (Tailwind, plain CSS or React), import a web page as a browser frame, and export the storyboard as PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF at 1x to 3x.

features.name: Code section
features.what: Before: no way to get a storyboard's code from the panel. Now: pick HTML + Tailwind, HTML + CSS or React (JSX), then Copy HTML or Export HTML. Export writes a standalone page into the canvas's exports folder, with its CSS inlined and images embedded.
features.how: Select a storyboard, pick the format in Code, then click Copy HTML or Export HTML. The gear has Copy as a full page, Embed images and Open exports folder.

items.title: Sticky notes that run as prompts
items.summary: A Sticky note tool (key N), copied from pen.dev, drops notes on the canvas. A Prompt note has a Run button that sends its text to the agent as a canvas task, and the note then shows that task's status and summary.

features.name: Sticky note tool
features.what: Before: no notes on the canvas. Now: press N and click to drop a note, or drag to draw one. A note is a Prompt (blue) or a Note (yellow), can be moved and resized, and Delete shows a 5 s Undo.
features.how: Press N (or the Sticky note tool), click on the canvas and type. Double click a note to edit it again.

features.name: Run a note as a prompt
features.what: Now: Run sends the note's text to the agent with the composer's model and effort. The note shows queued, running, needs input, done with a short summary, or failed with Retry, and follows the storyboard under it.
features.how: Write the prompt and click Run. Click Open to see the task's panel.

items.title: Properties panel for frames and notes
items.summary: Browser frames, shader frames and sticky notes get pen.dev's properties sections in the canvas's right panel, so they can be edited by hand without asking the agent. Each edit is written into the canvas file.

features.name: Position, size and appearance fields
features.what: Before: these frames and notes could only be moved or resized with the mouse. Now: when one is selected, the right panel shows its name, X and Y, W and H with a ratio lock, and opacity, corner radius and clip content.
features.how: Select a browser frame, shader frame or note, then type in a field. Drag a field's label sideways to scrub (Shift for x10), use the arrow keys to step, or type arithmetic such as 120+40.

features.name: Undo for manual edits
features.what: The app's canvas undo does not know these nodes, so the mod keeps its own history of 20 steps. Arrow steps on the same field within 1 s count as one.
features.how: Cmd+Z and Cmd+Shift+Z while a frame or note is selected or the panel has focus. localStorage "rtd.canvasProps" = "off" removes the panel.
